value.text:
## Instructions and terms

Supplier: Amberwick Office Works (synthetic)

Contract reference: NS-CON-001. Target: 95.00% of fully received purchase orders received on or before the original promised date. Open overdue orders remain failures at the cutoff. Escalate after 2 calendar days past promise. Payment term: 45 calendar days from invoice issue. All prices are GBP net of VAT. Partial receipts are allowed; over-receipts require rejection. Review below-target delivery performance; no automatic penalties are assumed.
